Api.//: Absolute base URL of the Crawldad API the portal calls through Crawldad.Client. Dev default is the API's local http profile; override per environment (e.g. Crawldad__Api__BaseUrl).

DataProtection.//: Persists the portal's ASP.NET Data Protection key ring so its auth cookies AND the Data-Protected tenant API keys stored on PortalTenantLink survive a container restart/replace (issue #119). This is the portal's OWN section + OWN ring, isolated from the API's Crawldad:DataProtection. BOTH set (the Azure deployment) => the key ring is stored in the KeyRingBlobUri blob (the portal's own container) and each key is wrapped by the KeyVaultKeyId Key Vault key, authenticated by the app's managed identity (set AZURE_CLIENT_ID for the user-assigned identity). BOTH empty (dev/test default) => the framework's default local key ring. Half-set fails fast at startup. The infra deploy feeds these via Crawldad__Portal__DataProtection__* env vars.

ConnectionStrings.//: Same shared devcontainer Postgres the API uses (throwaway dev credential); the portal isolates itself in the "portal" schema. Override with the ConnectionStrings__marten env var. Never commit real secrets.
